title: Toric decomposition in algebraic groups
summary: Over an arbitrary field $\mathbb{F}$, we construct $n+1$ maximal tori $T_1,\dots,T_{n+1}$ in $\operatorname{PGL}_n(\mathbb{F})$ so that the product $T_1\dots T_{n+1}$ is almost the whole $\operatorname{PGL}_n(\mathbb{F})$ and every $g\in T_1\dots T_{n+1}$ can be expressed uniquely as $g=t_1\dots t_{n+1}$ where $t_i\in T_i$. The construction is optimal, as the number of tori with this property attains a general upper bound for connected reductive groups over an algebraically closed field, as well as over finite fields.
